products.name: Wood Design Red
products.details: Wood Design Concrete Tiles replicate teak, oak, or mahogany visuals with chip- and warp-proof performance. The digitally printed surface withstands UV exposure and heavy furniture, making them ideal for: Outdoor decks & balconies Bathroom floors Commercial retail spaces Technical edge : DCOF >0.65 slip resistance and 20-year color warranty

products.name: Holland Plain 60mm Pavers
products.details: Engineered for versatility, these 60mm-thick concrete pavers feature a plain granular finish in neutral tones. Their uniform 100 × 200 mm dimensions enable seamless herringbone, stack bond, or basketweave patterns. With 50+ MPa compressive strength and ≤5% water absorption, they resist freeze-thaw cycles (-30°C to 65°C), de-icing salts, and heavy loads. ADA-compliant gaps ensure accessibility.

products.name: Wood Design Black
products.details: Wood Design Concrete Tiles replicate teak, oak, or mahogany visuals with chip- and warp-proof performance. The digitally printed surface withstands UV exposure and heavy furniture, making them ideal for: Outdoor decks & balconies Bathroom floors Commercial retail spaces Technical edge : DCOF >0.65 slip resistance and 20-year color warranty

products.name: Trihex Plain
products.details: Engineered for demanding environments, Trihex Pavers combine robust performance with aesthetic versatility. Their patented hexagonal design (186mm W × 92mm D × 80mm H) interlocks seamlessly to create continuous, crack-resistant surfaces without repetitive lines. Crafted from high-density concrete, they withstand freeze-thaw cycles, de-icing salts, and vehicular loads exceeding 3,500 kg axles . Compatible with permeable systems like Ecotrihex® for integrated stormwater management, these pavers offer textures ranging from smooth to shot-blasted for customized slip resistance. Key Innovations: Seamless Aesthetics : Hexagonal geometry enables fluid patterns ideal for large-scale projects (e.g., Sydney Olympic Park). Hybrid Permeability : Integrates with permeable Ecotrihex® pavers for eco-compliant drainage. Machine-Lay Ready : Optimized for mechanical installation, reducing labor costs by 30% . UV-Stable Colors : Iron oxide pigments retain vibrancy in oatmeal, charcoal, grey, and red finishes

products.name: BREEZE BLOCKS Square design 300x300x70
products.details: Square Design Breeze Block redefines spaces with its iconic grid-like design, offering privacy without sacrificing ventilation or natural light. Precision-manufactured using fine sand aggregate and hydraulic pressing, these blocks feature: Timeless Appeal : Clean, repetitive square motifs create striking shadow patterns for mid-century modern or contemporary projects. Climate Resilience : Withstands temperature extremes (-30°C to 65°C) and UV exposure due to ≤5% water absorption and frost-resistant concrete. Dual-Sided Finish : Smooth surfaces on both sides ensure a refined look for visible interiors or façades. Eco-Functional : Reduces cooling costs by promoting cross-ventilation; compatible with sustainable building practices 10 . Applications : Pool enclosures, garden screens, room dividers, and commercial façades.

products.name: Load Bearing Brick 220mm
products.details: Zimtile’s Load Bearing Concrete Bricks are precision-manufactured to meet rigorous construction demands. Designed for load-bearing applications, these bricks offer: Exceptional Strength : 10–15 MPa compressive strength supports multi-story buildings and heavy infrastructure. Climate Resilience : Withstands Zimbabwe’s diverse climate, including freeze-thaw cycles (-30°C to 65°C) and heavy rains, with ≤5% water absorption. Eco-Efficiency : Incorporates 20% recycled materials and reduces transport costs through local production. Fire Safety : Class A1 non-combustible rating ensures compliance with safety standards. Ideal for residential, commercial, and industrial projects requiring durability and cost-effectiveness.

products.name: Interlocking Red 60mm Pavers
products.details: Engineered for commercial resilience, Interlocking Red 60mm Pavers combine bold color retention and structural robustness. The interlocking design creates load-distributing rigidity, while high-density concrete (25–35 MPa tensile strength) ensures resistance to cracking, de-icing salts, and temperatures from -30°C to 65°C. UV-inhibited pigments maintain the rich red hue for decades, and the uniform dimensions enable rapid installation in herringbone or stack-bond patterns. Key Innovations: Shear-Key Interlock : Geometric edges prevent shifting under loads up to 3,000 kg axles . Weather Armor : ≤5% water absorption and freeze-thaw resilience. Eco-Options : Permeable joint compatibility reduces stormwater runoff. Applications : Commercial driveways, parking lots, industrial pathways, and municipal plazas.

products.name: Interlocking Plain 60mm Pavers
products.details: Engineered for efficiency, these 60mm-thick interlocking concrete pavers feature a plain granular finish and standardized 300 × 300 mm dimensions. The precision shear-key edges create rigid, load-distributing surfaces, while the ≤5% water absorption ensures resistance to freeze-thaw cycles (-30°C to 65°C) and de-icing salts. Compatible with permeable bases for sustainable stormwater management.

products.name: INTERLOCKING PLAIN 80MM * 225MM
products.details: Designed for ports, warehouses, and high-traffic areas, these extra-large pavers feature interlocking edges to prevent shifting under heavy vehicles. The 80mm thickness and 3:1 aspect ratio ensure structural integrity. Available in gray, charcoal, or terracotta.

products.name: Interlocking Black 60mm Pavers
products.details: Featuring precision-engineered edges for seamless interlock, these pavers create rigid pavements that distribute loads evenly. The dark granular finish hides dirt, while 60mm thickness ensures stability under traffic. Compatible with permeable bases for stormwater management.

products.name: Holland Red 60mm Pavers
products.details: Crafted with iron oxide pigments, these pavers retain their rich red hue under prolonged UV exposure. The 60mm thickness supports vehicular loads (≥3,000 kg axles), while tumbled edges enhance anti-slip properties. Exceeds ASTM C936 standards for compressive strength and weather resistance.

products.name: Holland Black 60mm Pavers
products.details: Achieve minimalist elegance with Holland Black 60mm Pavers —engineered for high-traffic durability and design versatility. These rectangular concrete pavers feature: Ultra-Dense Construction : 70 MPa compressive strength and ≤5% water absorption for freeze-thaw resistance (-30°C to 65°C). Low-Maintenance Finish : Granular charcoal-black surface hides stains and resists fading. Pattern Flexibility : Uniform sizing enables herringbone, stack bond, or mixed layouts. Eco-Compliance : Permeable base compatibility reduces stormwater runoff. Applications : Driveways, pedestrian zones, commercial plazas, and geometric garden accents.

products.name: Cassablanca Plain
products.details: Transport your hardscape to the Mediterranean with Cassablanca Pavers —meticulously engineered to emulate centuries-old cobblestone charm with contemporary performance. Crafted from high-density concrete (8,000–10,000 PSI), these pavers feature: Authentic Vintage Aesthetics : Softly tumbled edges and multi-tonal color blends (Terra Cotta, Sandalwood, Graphite) that hide dirt and wear. Commercial-Grade Resilience : Withstands freeze-thaw cycles (-30°F to 150°F), de-icing salts, and 12,000+ PSI vehicle loads (HD2 technology). Safety & Accessibility : Non-slip, textured finish (V3–V4 DIN slip rating) and ADA-compliant flat surfaces. Eco-Engineered : 23% recycled materials; permeable joint options for stormwater management. Applications : Driveways, pedestrian plazas, resort courtyards, and historic restorations.

information.text: Home .calltoaction-button.flat-button-large.calltoaction-button-2 a:hover { color:#E50011!important; background:#FBFBFB!important; border-color:#FBFBFB!important; } " class="calltoaction-button calltoaction-custom-js flat-button-large calltoaction-border-round calltoaction-align-center calltoaction-button-2 animate-in" data-anim-type="spin-reverse" data-anim-delay="100"> " Zimtile - Zimbabwes leading manufacturer and distributor of quality concrete roof tiles, bricks, pavers and other ancillary products." Founded in 1957, Zimtile is Zimbabwe’s leading manufacturer and distributor of high-quality concrete Roofing Tiles, Pavers,Bricks, Blocks, and related building materials. For over six decades, we have been at the heart of Zimbabwe’s construction industry — building the homes, schools, businesses, and infrastructure that define our nation. Our legacy is built on a foundation of quality, reliability, and innovation. With every product we produce, we contribute not just to structures, but to communities and futures. We are proud to be the name behind thousands of successful projects across the country — from residential developments to major commercial and public works. At Zimtile, we believe in continuous improvement. Our materials are engineered to meet the unique climate and durability demands of Zimbabwe’s environment, while our team works tirelessly to ensure that every solution we provide adds value, strength, and longevity to your buildings. With a nationwide footprint of strategically located manufacturing plants and distribution branches, we guarantee consistent availability and fast delivery, wherever you are. We are more than a supplier — we are a trusted partner in progress. “We don’t just supply materials; we build the foundation of Zimbabwe’s future.” This is the promise that drives us every day — shaping the nation’s future, one brick, one tile at a time. Mission Statement Our mission is to lead the construction industry by manufacturing and distributing superior quality concrete roof tiles, bricks, pavers, and other complementary products that meet the evolving needs of our customers. We proudly serve both private and public sector clients — including individuals, property developers, construction companies, and government institutions — across Zimbabwe and the broader region. Our Vision To be the most trusted experts in the production and distribution of premium-quality, cost-effective concrete roof tiles and related building solutions .
